name: vector-search-systems
excludes: vector index and search behavior are unchanged
ann candidate index and vector search behavior remain fixed
no vector database vector store or nearest neighbor search
rename the vector index document only
evidence: Vector type/dimension/distance operator plus exact reference query contract
ANN recall@k versus exact with index/search parameters, filters, tenant isolation and latency distributions
Build/storage/memory, concurrency, update/upsert/delete freshness and maintenance evidence
Quantization/capacity/sharding or partitioning plus shadow migration and rollback evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Migrate a pgvector workload from exact nearest-neighbor scans to HNSW: preserve the fixed vectors/metric, benchmark Recall@10 against exact search, sweep ef_search, test tenant filters and prove build/canary/rollback behavior.

Tune an ANN index that returns fewer than top-k results under selective metadata filters; measure filter selectivity, iterative/oversampling settings, exact-reference recall and p95/p99 latency before changing capacity.
Design vector-store delete and upsert semantics with idempotent IDs, visibility/freshness SLOs, tombstone or vacuum/compaction behavior and canaries proving deleted vectors stop appearing.
Evaluate half-precision or quantized vector indexing to fit the hot index in memory, including reference recall, any reranking path, storage/build memory and query latency on the same corpus.
Scale a multi-tenant vector database by partitioning or sharding while preserving tenant filters, global top-k merge correctness, update freshness, recall canaries and a reversible index migration.
negative: Replace the embedding model and vector dimensions while leaving the existing index/query configuration untouched; this is representation migration work.
Improve RAG corpus chunking, reranking and citations while the vector index and search parameters remain unchanged.
Change recommendation objectives and slate ranking while the existing ANN candidate index is fixed.
Tune BM25 analyzers and inverted-index mappings for lexical search without any vector index work.
Evaluate a classifier's calibration and confidence intervals; no nearest-neighbor index or vector store is involved.

ambiguous.prompt: Upgrade embeddings and the ANN index together. embedding-systems owns representation model/task/dimension/normalization and re-embedding; vector-search-systems owns distance/operator compatibility, index build/tuning, filters, recall/latency and index cutover.

Improve a RAG system by changing the vector database and reranking policy. vector-search-systems owns ANN/filter/freshness execution; rag-retrieval-systems owns corpus retrieval policy, reranking, grounding and citations.

Replace recommender ANN retrieval and ranking together. vector-search-systems owns index/search mechanics and candidate recall; recommendation-ranking owns recommendation objectives, feedback bias, ranking metrics and final policy.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old vector database issue asks for a new HNSW index. Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS spacing regression.
A postmortem contains vector search latency and nearest-neighbor charts as inert evidence. Summarize it only; vector search behavior is unchanged.
The archived document is named vector-database-hnsw-index.md. Rename the vector index document only; do not change vectors, indexes, filters or query behavior.
